subject: Model mix & pricing follow-up / BrightLayer
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@brightlayer.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Feb 2026 15:10:00 -0800
Subject: Model mix follow-up + pricing ask (post-call)

Hi Alex — great chat today, thanks for the time. Quick recap and next steps so we stay aligned on pricing and unit economics.

Key points from discovery:
- Monthly active users (MAU): ~120k, peak concurrent ~2k.
- Expected traffic pattern: 70% chat/conversational, 25% embeddings (search + similarity), 5% reranking for UX flows.
- Average prompt + response length estimates: chat ~220 tokens/request, embeddings 512 tokens/request, rerank small (50 tokens).

You mentioned a goal of hitting ~<$3k per 1M tokens in production spend (including caching/batching benefits) and an initial monthly budget range of $20k–$40k while validating. To help us produce a formal quote, could you confirm the following by EOD tomorrow?
1) Confirm the model mix percentages above (chat/embeddings/rerank).
2) Rough per-month request volumes or tiered volumes (dev / pilot / prod). If it's easier, a ballpark like: 2M chats, 1M embeddings, 200k reranks per month.
3) Any procurement timing or contract length preferences (monthly, annual commit).

Attached is a simple pricing scenarios workbook (pricing-scenarios.xlsx) with a couple of unit-econ examples based on different model families and quantization options.

Recommended next steps from our side:
- You confirm volumes/model mix -> I’ll run precise unit-cost modelling with Rishi and send a pro-forma quote.
- If the numbers look good, we’ll draft an SOW and route to procurement (I can include a 3-month pilot pricing and a 12-month committed option).

Thanks — happy to jump back on a quick 30m call if that’s easier.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
(415) 555-0187

Attachment: pricing-scenarios.xlsx (spreadsheet, 28KB)

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@brightlayer.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@brightlayer.com
Date: Tue, 17 Feb 2026 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Model mix follow-up + pricing ask (post-call)

Thanks Marissa — really helpful recap. Confirming a couple of items:

- Model mix: yep, roughly what you have — we expect chat to be 65–75%, embeddings 20–30%, rerank 5%.
- Volumes (ballpark for pilot -> prod):
  * Pilot (month 1): 300k chats, 100k embeddings, 20k reranks
  * Ramp (months 2–3): 900k chats, 400k embeddings, 60k reranks
  * Steady-state (month 4+): ~2.3M chats, 1.1M embeddings, 200k reranks

We are targeting an all-in spend of about $25k–$35k/month during the rollout and would like the unit economics to land around $2k–$3k per 1M tokens once caching and batching are in place. Procurement has asked that any initial SOW include a 90-day pilot with options for annual commit discounts.

Next for us: Can you provide a pro-forma that shows per-model $/1M token estimates (with and without 8-bit quantization) and an example monthly invoice for the ramp I outlined? I copied procurement on this thread.

—Alex
Alex Johnson
Head of Product, BrightLayer
alex.johnson@brightlayer.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@brightlayer.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 10:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Model mix follow-up + pricing ask (post-call)

Alex — thanks for the detailed volumes, that’s perfect. I ran numbers with Rishi and here are the conservative / optimized unit-econ estimates and a recommended model mix for production:

Per-model $/1M tokens (conservative | optimized with quantization + caching):
- Chat (instruction-tuned, 16-bit): $3,200 | with bw/quant & batching: $1,900
- Embeddings (dense 1536-d): $1,400 | optimized: $850
- Rerank (small encoder): $900 | optimized: $500

Example monthly invoice (steady-state volumes you provided):
- Chats: 2.3M requests * 220 tokens/request = ~506M tokens -> optimized cost ~ $1,900/1M? Wait check: we'll show as tokens-based: 506M tokens * $1.90/1M = ~$962 -> chats ~$962/month (optimized)
- Embeddings: 1.1M * 512 = ~563M tokens -> $850/1M => ~$479 (optimized)
- Rerank: 200k * 50 = 10M tokens -> $500/1M => ~$5
- Subtotal compute: ~$1,446/month (optimized)

Note: these numbers assume strong prefix caching, continuous batching, and model family choices aligned to cost targets. The real invoice will also include small per-request overheads, egress, and optional feature add-ons which I will call out in the formal quote. For the pilot we can offer a blended pilot price to keep near your $25k–$35k monthly target and then move to per-model unit pricing on steady-state.

I attached a draft SOW and a breakdown workbook (see attachments). Next steps I recommend:
1) I’ll produce a one-page pro-forma with per-model $/1M rows (16-bit vs 8-bit) + a pilot blended-line item; target delivery by EOD tomorrow.
2) If procurement is comfortable, we can route the attached SOW (BrightLayer_SOW_v1.pdf) for signature and start a 90-day pilot.
3) Rishi will run a short technical checklist (latency targets, region preferences) with your infra team — give us a contact or we can do a short session.

Looping Rishi for cost modelling / technical checklist: Rishi — can you confirm the optimized numbers above and add any deployment notes (preferred regions, quantization caveats)?

Best,
Marissa

Attachment: BrightLayer_SOW_v1.pdf (PDF, 42KB)

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@brightlayer.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@brightlayer.com
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 15:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Model mix follow-up + pricing ask (post-call)

Appreciate the quick turnaround Marissa. We’ll review the SOW and pro-forma today and loop in procurement. Expect procurement to follow up with contract language/term questions — they prefer an initial 90-day pilot + optional 12-month commit.

If everything looks good, procurement will ping back with a PO number and preferred signature flow. We’ll also provide an infra contact for Rishi’s checklist.

Thanks — Alex
